Item.Name: S_FROM_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter starting date in MM-DD-YY format . Leave blank for all open boxes.

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
Declare
 v_localdate date;
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 /* To display local time*/
 if is_timezone_enabled 
 then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate , chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate:= sysdate;
 end if;
 --if :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date>get_local_date -- IM5454s
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date>chp_sysdate +1 then
 show_error_dist('0503');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is null then
 GO_ITEM ('s_to_date');
 CLEAR_ITEM ;
 GO_ITEM ('s_include_flag');
 else
 NEXT_ITEM;
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: S_TO_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter ending date in MM-DD-YY format.

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
Declare
 v_localdate date;
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 /* To display local time*/
 if is_timezone_enabled 
 then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate , chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate:= sysdate;
 end if;

 --if :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date>sysdate IM 5454
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date> chp_sysdate+1
 then
 show_error_dist('0503');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date < :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date
 then
 show_error_dist('1532');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date is null then
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date := chp_sysdate;
 end if;
 NEXT_ITEM;
end;

Item.Name: S_INCLUDE_FLAG
Item.Hint: Enter 'Y' to report open boxes from discard and manufacturing customers?

Trigger.Name: KEY-PREV-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if (:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is null) then
 GO_ITEM ('s_from_date');
 else

end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
if (:ctrl_blk_1.s_include_flag != 'Y' and
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_include_flag != 'N')
 then
 show_error_dist('0318');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 go_block('boxes');
 execute_query;
 execute_trigger('calculate_total');
 if(:boxes.box_id is null) then
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 message ('No open boxes found within specified parameters');
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 0;
end;

Block.Name: BOXES
Block.WhereClause: where ((:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is null) or (Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,insert_date) between :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date+.9999,sysdate))) and box_status = 'OP' and warehouse_id=:GLOBAL.warehouse and chapter_id=:GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID and (:ctrl_blk_1.s_include_flag = 'Y' or exists ( select 'X' from pick_slip_products psp, pick_slips ps, orders o, customers c where psp.box_id = boxes.box_id and psp.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.g_chapter_id and ps.pick_slip_id = psp.pick_slip_id and ps.chapter_id = psp.chapter_id and o.order_no = ps.order_no and o.chapter_id = ps.chapter_id and c.customer_id = o.customer_id and c.chapter_id = o.chapter_id and c.customer_type not in ('DI','MG')))

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;

begin
 begin
 select class_desc into :s_order_type from
 vserv_order_classes
 where order_priority in (
 select min(voc.order_priority) from
 vserv_order_classes voc, orders o, pick_slips ps,
 pick_slip_products psp
 where psp.box_id = :box_id
 and psp.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and ps.pick_slip_id = psp.pick_slip_id
 and ps.chapter_id = psp.chapter_id
 and o.order_no = ps.order_no
 and o.chapter_id = ps.chapter_id
 and voc.order_class = o.order_class
 and voc.chapter_id = o.chapter_id)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception when NO_DATA_FOUND then null;
 end;
 begin
 select name, customer_type into
 :s_customer_name, :s_customer_type
 from customers
 where customer_id in (
 select min(cus.customer_id) from
 customers cus, orders o, pick_slips ps,
 pick_slip_products psp
 where psp.box_id = :box_id
 and psp.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and ps.pick_slip_id = psp.pick_slip_id
 and ps.chapter_id = psp.chapter_id
 and o.order_no = ps.order_no
 and o.chapter_id = ps.chapter_id
 and cus.customer_id = o.customer_id
 and cus.chapter_id = o.chapter_id)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception when NO_DATA_FOUND then null;
 end;
 begin
 select min(o.insert_date) into :s_order_date from
 orders o, pick_slips ps, pick_slip_products psp
 where psp.box_id = :box_id
 and psp.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and ps.pick_slip_id = psp.pick_slip_id
 and ps.chapter_id = psp.chapter_id
 and o.order_no = ps.order_no
 and o.chapter_id = ps.chapter_id;
 
 -- time zone change --03/04/11--sandip
 if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(:boxes.packed_date,'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 :boxes.s_packed_date := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI');
 end if; 

 exception when NO_DATA_FOUND then null;
 end;
 
 -- time zone change --03/04/11--sandip
 if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(:boxes.insert_date,'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 :boxes.s_order_date := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM-DD-YY'),'MM-DD-YY');
 end if; 

end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_LOCAL_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION get_local_date(v_date IN DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE) RETURN DATE
/* Function to return local date value, in case no parameter this
will return system date converted to local date--*/
 IS
 v_localdate DATE;
BEGIN
 /* To display local time*/
 if is_timezone_enabled 
 then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_date ,v_localdate);
 else
 v_localdate := sysdate;
 end if;

 return v_localdate;
END;

Trigger.Name: CALCULATE_TOTAL
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 begin
 select count(*) into :ctrl_blk_1.s_total_orders from boxes
 where ((:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is null) or
 (insert_date between :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date and
 nvl (:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date+.9999,sysdate)))
 and box_status = 'OP'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception when NO_DATA_FOUND then null;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*) into :ctrl_blk_1.s_reported from boxes
 where ((:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date is null) or
 (insert_date between :ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date and
 nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date+.9999,sysdate)))
 and box_status = 'OP'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 and (:ctrl_blk_1.s_include_flag = 'Y' or exists
 (select 'X' from pick_slip_products psp,
 pick_slips ps, orders o, customers c
 where psp.box_id = boxes.box_id
 and psp.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.g_chapter_id
 and ps.pick_slip_id = psp.pick_slip_id
 and ps.chapter_id = psp.chapter_id
 and o.order_no = ps.order_no
 and o.chapter_id = ps.chapter_id
 and c.customer_id = o.customer_id
 and c.chapter_id = o.chapter_id
 and c.customer_type not in ('DI','MG')));
 exception when NO_DATA_FOUND then null;
 end;
end;
